image_title: Tool Verification for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
summary: This document presents tables and figures related to the performance of various models in tool verification for test-time reinforcement learning. Table 1 outlines main results for models including Queen-2.5-1.5B and Queen-3.4B, showing values such as 7.7, 28.6, 32.7, 23.0 for the baseline and 20.8, 50.9, 74.6, 48.8 for w/TRL. Table 2 details the MATH-500 difficulty breakdown, with Queen-Math-1.5B showing a relative improvement of 6.3% over baseline on AIME 2024. Figure 4 illustrates the relative gain over baseline trend for TRL versus w/TRL across different difficulty levels, indicating improvements of up to 11.9%. The analysis highlights that math-specialized backbones benefit significantly from tool verification, particularly on harder benchmarks, with notable performance gains across various models.
